connectionParameters.label: API ID
connectionParameters.name: api_id
connectionParameters.desc: Imperva Cloud WAF API ID (sent as the x-API-Id header)

connectionParameters.label: API Key
connectionParameters.name: api_key
connectionParameters.desc: Imperva Cloud WAF API key (sent as the x-API-Key header)

connectionParameters.label: Base URL
connectionParameters.name: base_url
connectionParameters.desc: Imperva provisioning API base URL (default: https://my.imperva.com/api/prov/v1)

desc: Imperva Cloud WAF (Incapsula) integration for web application firewall response and investigation. Block or unblock IPs, allowlist IPs, block countries, and add security (Incap) rules on a protected site; list sites, get site status, and retrieve account audit-trail events. Authentication is via the Imperva API ID / API key pair.

functions.label: Block IP
functions.name: block_ip
functions.desc: Add IP address(es) to a site's blacklisted IPs ACL to block them.

inParameters.label: Site ID
inParameters.name: site_id
inParameters.desc: Numeric identifier of the site to operate on

inParameters.label: IPs
inParameters.name: ips
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list of IP addresses to block

functions.label: Unblock IP
functions.name: unblock_ip
functions.desc: Set the site's blacklisted IPs ACL to the provided list (pass the remaining IPs to remove one; an empty list clears all blacklisted IPs).

inParameters.label: Site ID
inParameters.name: site_id
inParameters.desc: Numeric identifier of the site to operate on

inParameters.label: IPs
inParameters.name: ips
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list of IPs that should remain blacklisted (empty clears the blacklist)

functions.label: Allowlist IP
functions.name: allowlist_ip
functions.desc: Set a site's whitelisted IPs ACL.

inParameters.label: Site ID
inParameters.name: site_id
inParameters.desc: Numeric identifier of the site to operate on

inParameters.label: IPs
inParameters.name: ips
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list of IP addresses to allowlist

functions.label: Block Country
functions.name: block_country
functions.desc: Set a site's blacklisted countries ACL.

inParameters.label: Site ID
inParameters.name: site_id
inParameters.desc: Numeric identifier of the site to operate on

inParameters.label: Countries
inParameters.name: countries
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list of two-letter country codes (and/or continent codes) to block

functions.label: Add Security Rule
functions.name: add_security_rule
functions.desc: Add a security rule (IncapRule) to a site, e.g. to block an IP by filter.

inParameters.label: Site ID
inParameters.name: site_id
inParameters.desc: Numeric identifier of the site to operate on

inParameters.label: Name
inParameters.name: name
inParameters.desc: Name of the security rule

inParameters.label: Action
inParameters.name: action
inParameters.desc: Rule action

inParameters.label: Filter
inParameters.name: filter
inParameters.desc: The rule trigger filter (IncapRules syntax; up to 400 characters)

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: API response (includes the created rule ID)

functions.label: List Sites
functions.name: list_sites
functions.desc: List the sites in the account.

inParameters.label: Account ID
inParameters.name: account_id
inParameters.desc: Numeric identifier of the account (defaults to the authenticated account)

inParameters.label: Page Size
inParameters.name: page_size
inParameters.desc: Number of objects to return per page (default 50)

inParameters.label: Page Number
inParameters.name: page_num
inParameters.desc: Page to return, starting from 0 (default 0)

functions.label: Get Site Status
functions.name: get_site_status
functions.desc: Get the status and configuration of a site.

inParameters.label: Site ID
inParameters.name: site_id
inParameters.desc: Numeric identifier of the site to operate on

inParameters.label: Tests
inParameters.name: tests
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list of tests to run before returning status: domain_validation, services, dns

inParameters.label: Account ID
inParameters.name: account_id
inParameters.desc: Numeric identifier of the account (defaults to the authenticated account)

inParameters.label: Start
inParameters.name: start
inParameters.desc: Start time in milliseconds since 1970

inParameters.label: End
inParameters.name: end
inParameters.desc: End time in milliseconds since 1970

inParameters.label: Page Size
inParameters.name: page_size
inParameters.desc: Number of objects to return per page (default 50, max 100)

inParameters.label: Page Number
inParameters.name: page_num
inParameters.desc: Page to return, starting from 0
